evidence.sourceTitle: Galaxea Open-World Dataset official release documentation
evidence.locator: Dataset Structure; LeRobot Dataset Schema: Observations, Actions, Metadata Columns
evidence.statement: The official card documents per-episode Parquet and camera MP4 files, robot observation/action vectors, timestamps and episode/frame indices in LeRobot format. This directly establishes aligned mobile-manipulation transitions.
